blocks.text: Violetta is a female given name. Notable people with the name include:

items: Violetta (performer) (1907–1973), real name Aloisia Wagner, German performer born without arms and legs
Violetta Khrapina Bida, Olympic épée fencer
Violetta Blue, a name previously used by the American pornographic actress now known as Noname Jane
Violetta J'Adore, Greek Cypriot drag queen based in London
Violetta Kiss (1925–1994), Soviet acrobat, juggler, director and teacher
Violetta Napierska (1890–1968), Italian film actress, also active in German silent films
Violette Nozière (murderer) (1915-1966), French criminal accused of attempting to poison her parents
Violetta Oblinger-Peters, German-born, Austrian slalom canoer
Violetta Thurstan (1879–1978), English nurse and weaver
Violetta Villas (1938–2011), Polish singer and actress
Violetta White Delafield (1875–1949), American amateur mycologist

blocks.text: The violetta was a 16th-century musical instrument.

Violetta is an Argentine telenovela filmed in Buenos Aires, Argentina and developed by Disney Channel Latin America and Europe, Middle East and Africa (EMEA) and production company Pol-ka, debuted in Argentina, Latin America and Italy on 14 May 2012.
